notes: Legacy V1 diagnostic-registry-v1. Audited metric: Price range plus liquidity event. Coverage input: Price/volume phase proxies. Legacy audit class: DUPLICATE_COMPUTATION. Lite interpretation: Consume pool/event evidence, then phase interpretation. Legacy evaluation mode: HYBRID. Legacy operational state: OPERATIONAL_CURRENT_DESCRIPTIVE. No thresholds, direct score, gates, strategy or order authority migrated.

result_semantics.PASS: Only an accepted V1 result confirming Price range plus liquidity event from certified inputs may be PASS; no threshold is defined by this artifact.
result_semantics.CAUTION: No direct V1 CAUTION status exists; a future reviewed mapping of V1 NEUTRAL or mixed Wyckoff phase evidence is required. Missing input is not CAUTION.
result_semantics.FAIL: Only an accepted V1 result finding adverse Price range plus liquidity event from certified inputs may be FAIL; no threshold is defined by this artifact.
result_semantics.UNKNOWN: V1 INSUFFICIENT_DATA or UNVERIFIED for missing, stale, noncomparable, conflicting or unsupported Price range plus liquidity event; never PASS.
